blueprints.title: 三笠 · 城墙巡逻
blueprints.description: 【三笠 · 城墙巡逻】帕拉迪岛的高墙之上，三笠立于垛口边俯瞰墙内，棕色制服与绿披风在风中猎猎作响，红色围巾在颈间轻轻扬起——「城墙之内，就是我必须守住的答案。」

blueprints.promptProse: Standing guard upon the colossal stone ramparts of Wall Maria adjusting her red wool scarf, Mikasa observes the horizon with calm lethal vigilance. Vast sky clouds and sweeping high-altitude winds frame her steadfast protector stance.

blueprints.title: 三笠 · 森林立体机动
blueprints.description: 【三笠 · 森林立体机动】树海之间，三笠借着立体机动装置从巨树之间疾掠而过，双刀出鞘带起两道寒芒，红围巾在高速中被拉成一条笔直的线——「障碍越多，我只会更快。」
blueprints.camera: cowboy shot, perching on giant tree branch with dual blades
blueprints.promptProse: Soaring through the giant redwood forest on high-speed ODM wire hooks drawing dual steel blades, Mikasa attacks with unmatched precision. Venting white gas trails and dappled canopy sunbeams highlight her extraordinary combat agility.

blueprints.title: 三笠 · 训练兵团操场
blueprints.description: 【三笠 · 训练兵团操场】训练兵团的操场上，三笠在白制服外系着立体机动装置的束带，从人群中独自走出来，红围巾在风中一动不动般沉静——「训练是为了活下去。仅此而已。」
blueprints.camera: cowboy shot, ready combat stance on dirt training field
blueprints.promptProse: Adopting a disciplined hand-to-hand combat stance on the sun-baked training grounds, Mikasa raises her fists with focused, stoic determination. Her cadet uniform shirt is lightly dusted, her dark short hair framing her sharp, beautiful facial features. Wooden training dummies, obstacle courses, and distant stone barracks stand under the midday sky.

blueprints.title: 三笠 · 常服咖啡店

blueprints.promptProse: Sitting at a quiet wooden table in a Trost district cafe, Mikasa holds a steaming ceramic teacup in both hands, her red scarf wrapped softly around her neck. In her simple civilian blouse and dark skirt, her expression is serene and contemplative under the warm amber cafe lights, with rustic brick walls, wood-framed windows, and chalkboard menus framing the tranquil scene.

blueprints.title: 三笠 · 马莱街头

blueprints.promptProse: Standing in the shadow of a stone archway along a Liberio street at dusk, Mikasa wears a dark belted trench coat, her black hair cut short and sleek as her piercing gaze cuts through the twilight. Streetlamps flicker to life along the paved avenue, casting long dramatic shadows across old European-style facades and tram tracks.

blueprints.promptProse: Standing gracefully before the royal throne during her coronation, Queen Historia Reiss wears a magnificent white-and-gold royal mantle and a delicate golden crown atop her flowing blonde hair. Her pure blue eyes shine with newfound resolve and queenly grace as she holds the royal scepter. Grand cathedral archways, stained-glass windows, and cheering noble banners create an awe-inspiring royal ceremony.

Towering bookshelves, maps of the Walls, and burning oil lamps surround her in regal, scholarly warmth.

blueprints.camera: full body
blueprints.promptProse: During a break in the corps march across the grassland, Historia Reiss ties her golden hair into a low ponytail and turns back with her gentle smile, framed in a cowboy shot from the tops of her boots to the top of her head, her whole figure holding the foreground The brown jacket and green cape shift in the wind as she holds out a ration pack, her blue eyes warm and open. Pitched tents, tethered horses, supply wagons, a cook fire, stacked gear and a banner pole crowd the camp close around her, bright sunlight washing over the grass. A finished anime illustration with a clear focal subject, layered depth, and cinematic atmosphere.

Her light summer day dress flutters in the warm breeze, blonde hair shining radiantly under the afternoon sun. Sculpted marble fountains, blooming flowerbeds, and distant palace spires form a serene, idyllic royal sanctuary.

Dressed in humble country clothes with an apron, her golden hair is tied in a loose ponytail, farm fields, grazing cattle, and rustic wooden barns glowing under the golden afternoon sun.
